fwci: Typical work: for works published 2020, the median FWCI is 0.21. In every year, half of the works received at most 21% of the citations expected for similar works worldwide (FWCI 1 = world average).
Above the world average: 17% of the works per year have an FWCI above 1.
Not cited: on average 44% of these works have FWCI 0, meaning no citations within their four-year window. That is why many boxes start at 0.

Mean versus median: the mean is above the median in 1 of 1 years, because a few highly cited works pull the average up. The widest gap is 2020: mean 0.46, median 0.21, top work 2.35. The median is the better guide to a typical work.
Still counting: works from 2024–2026 have not completed their four-year citation window, so their values will rise. Do not compare them with older years yet.
Small base: the values for 2020 and 2024–2026 are based on only 10–29 works (lighter box or hollow point), so read them with care.
Few works: 2015, 2019 and 2022 have fewer than 10 works (2015: 5, 2019: 5, 2022: 9), too few for a box. Each of those works is drawn as a dot.
citations: Typical work: works published 2020–2022 have a median of 0–1 citations each; the highest median (1) is in 2020.
Most cited works: the top 10% of works published in 2020 have at least 6 citations each, the highest P90 in the chart.
Not yet cited: more than half of the works published 2022–2026 have no citations so far. This is expected for recent works and is not a sign of low quality.

Mean versus median: the mean is above the median in 2 of 2 years, because a few highly cited works pull the average up. The widest gap is 2020: mean 2, median 1, top work 9. The median is the better guide to a typical work.
Recent years: works from 2024–2026 have had less than three years to be cited, so their values will rise.
Small base: the values for 2020, 2022 and 2024–2026 are based on only 10–29 works (lighter box or hollow point), so read them with care.
Few works: 2015 and 2019 have fewer than 10 works (2015: 6, 2019: 6), too few for a band. Each of those works is drawn as a dot.
